views.markdown:
**Downloads, background audio and an ad-free YouTube** — without changing how the app looks.

Everything lives in one place: an **ASJTube** tab in YouTube's own bar.

screenshots.accessibilityText: Save any video, up to 4K. Every quality it has, with the size shown before you tap.
YouTube Music, built in. Find any song from the library search, then play it or save it as audio.
Whole playlists, in one go. Paste a playlist link; videos you already have are skipped.
Your own library. What you saved, laid out like Home, with playlists, Watch later and search.
Shorts, saved your way. Video, audio or photo, from the button on every Short.
Nothing but the video. Clear Mode hides the whole interface on a Short, in one tap.

views.markdown:
- **Save any video or Short** — from the player, from a long press, from the Shorts button, or from YouTube's own Download row
- **My Library** — a feed of what you saved, laid out like Home, with its own player, playlists, Watch later and a storage bar
- Background playback and Picture in Picture for your own files

- **Watch videos in high quality** — pinned to the best rendition the video has
- **Background Playback** — audio keeps going when you leave the app or lock the screen
- **Picture in Picture** — starts on its own, no button to press
- Autoplay when a video finishes, and no suggested grid at the end
- Progress bar in Shorts

- **Remove Ads** — feed, search, Shorts and the player alike, refused before a card is ever built
- Non-skippable breaks are seeked past, skippable ones are skipped the moment the app allows it
- The Premium prompts, the upsell panels and the in-app surveys are all declined

- **Lyrics** for the song a video plays
- **Copy and translate any text** — a title, a description, a comment or one of its replies
- Hide Shorts, hide the create button, open the app on Shorts
- Require Face ID to open YouTube
- Open links in Safari instead of the in-app browser
- **Follows YouTube's own language** — all 79 of them

- **Download a whole playlist.** Paste its link in My library — videos you already have are skipped.
- **YouTube Music in the library search.** Play any song, or save it as audio.
- **Also new:** sleep timer, SponsorBlock, an app icon picker, and switches for the channel watermark and the still-watching prompt.
- **The ASJ tab opens ASJTube's settings again.**
- **Works with the newest YouTube, 21.39.4.**
- **General improvements and fixes.**

views.title: Not jailbroken? Get it for TrollStore

views.markdown:
- **Download a whole playlist.** Paste its link in My library — videos you already have are skipped.
- **YouTube Music in the library search.** Play any song, or save it as audio.
- **Also new:** sleep timer, SponsorBlock, an app icon picker, and switches for the channel watermark and the still-watching prompt.
- **The ASJ tab opens ASJTube's settings again.**
- **Works with the newest YouTube, 21.39.4.**
- **General improvements and fixes.**

- **Every menu, message and dialog is the app's own now.** Same look, same place, same wording as YouTube.
- **Downloads report the way YouTube reports its own** — a notification at the bottom, and rows at the top of My library.
- **Opening a YouTube link from Safari no longer closes the app.**
- General improvements and fixes.

- **Works with every YouTube version.**
- **Picture in Picture no longer turns itself on.** YouTube's own switch is now turned off for each account you sign in with.
- General improvements and fixes.

- **Playback quality fixes.**
- **No more "Something went wrong" on Wi-Fi.** A weak or busy connection now steps down a quality rung instead of giving up.
- General improvements and fixes.

- **Copy and translate inside a comment.** From the comment's own three dots, replies included — and the long press now opens YouTube's own sheet.
- **Translate into any language, on any iOS.** The list used to come up empty on older devices.
- **Supports older versions of YouTube**, not just the newest one.
- **History and playlists no longer empty out** with *Remove recommended videos at the end* turned on.
- General improvements and fixes.
